description: Patch releases of GitLab are automerged once CI is green, as they never cross a required upgrade stop.
Minor and major releases need a human review - see docs/updating-gitlab.md.

packageRules.description: GitLab's image tags carry the edition and a package revision (e.g. `19.4.1-ce.0`), while `gitlab_version` only holds the version itself (e.g. `19.4.1`).

GitLab can only be upgraded through its required upgrade stops (e.g. 19.2, 19.5, 19.8 and 19.11). One pull request (and therefore one release of this role) per minor version keeps the role's releases from skipping them.
